name: Bonegarden Spines
introDiscord:
Leviathan spines rise from the seabed like an ivory garden.

Bonegarden Urchins have settled between them, resulting in a landscape
where EVERYTHING is pointy.
introTwitch:
Leviathan spines rise from the seabed like an ivory garden.

Bonegarden Urchins have settled between them, resulting in a landscape
where EVERYTHING is pointy.

bonegarden-spines-approach.prompt: Three paths cross between enormous vertebral spines.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's abandoned glove.

Her note:

'Bone spikes.
Urchin spikes.
Coral spikes.

Area review:

too many spikes.'

right.message: A navigator's chest is wedged between two ancient spines.

forward.message:
A Bonegarden Urchin rolls from behind a Leviathan spine.

The smaller spikes have become mobile.

left.message:
An Urchin sits perfectly between the bone spikes.

You briefly fail to identify which spikes belong to whom.

right.message:
Shizuki left medicine inside a padded shell:

'Spike-related emergency kit.

I should have made this earlier.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the spike kit untouched.

forward.message: A wrecked strongbox rests beneath an enormous vertebra.

bonegarden-spines-threshold.prompt:
Ivory Thornfield lies beyond three passages surrounded by increasingly
dense bone.

left.message: Star Candies glitter inside the hollow of an ancient spine.

right.message:
An Urchin rolls down the bone toward you.

It has weaponized gravity AND spikes.

forward.message:
A calm pocket holds Shizuki's second kit:

'More spike medicine.

No commentary.

Area still pointy.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the medicine untouched.

Area remains pointy.

bossPromptDiscord:
The smallest Urchins scatter.

At the center of Ivory Thornfield, an enormous crown of glowing spines
begins moving between the Leviathan bones.

Use /yes to enter the Thornfield or /no to choose the revolutionary
strategy of avoiding spikes.
bossPromptTwitch:
The smallest Urchins scatter.

At the center of Ivory Thornfield, an enormous crown of glowing spines
begins moving between the Leviathan bones.

Use !yes to enter the Thornfield or !no to choose the revolutionary
strategy of avoiding spikes.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat.

For once, nobody gets poked.

boss.revealText:
A massive Urchin rises beneath a crown of ivory-colored spines.

Marrow-Crown Urchin reveals itself!

completionText:
The Marrow-Crown settles among the bones.

You leave the Bonegarden with exactly the recommended number of extra
holes:

zero.
